The following events took place in '''16 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] married [[Sintas Vel]].<ref name="Bloodlines3">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', Chapter 3</ref>
*[[BIX]] and [[Gee Long]] win the [[Drainsweeper/Legends|Drainsweeper]] [[Wikipedia:Relay race|relay race]] event at the [[Roon Colonial Games]] for the third consecutive [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="The Roon Games">{{DroidsCite|The Roon Games}}</ref>

==Battles==
*[[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|Battle of Dantooine]] {{C|Possible date}}<ref name="ESdate">The narration in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' states that fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] had elapsed between the [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|battle]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[X2]]'s meeting with [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. Their meeting occurred at a point before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but after the [[Corellian Treaty|formation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which took place in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
